query.statement: SELECT PURCHASE_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID, ORDER_DATE, INCOMING_DATE, ORDER_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@vendorId IS NULL OR VENDOR_ID = @vendorId) ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 충돌 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). INSERT INTO PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER (PURCHASE_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID, ORDER_QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@purchaseOrderId, @plantId, @purchaseOrderName, @vendorId, @orderQty, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(PURCHASE_ORDER_ID) DO UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = excluded.PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME = excluded.PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID = excluded.VENDOR_ID, ORDER_QTY = excluded.ORDER_QTY, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
